short_description: Measure digital microphone headroom, held peak and clipping during a soundcheck.
description: Measure digital microphone headroom, held peak and clipping during a soundcheck. Pipe mono, signed 16-bit little-endian PCM into python3 companion/meter.py ~/mic-levels.json, and set levels_file to that path. On macOS, for example, ffmpeg -f avfoundation -i :0 -ac 1 -ar 16000 -f s16le - feeds the meter over a pipe. The meter stores only aggregate level readings. Restart the meter to clear its held peak. This measures digital full scale, not acoustic sound pressure.
